notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Mars Odyssey, 40% off!
notes.notes:
Mars Odyssey is Now Available on Steam and is 40% off!*

Mars Odyssey is a single player VR simulator experience. Land on Earth’s sister planet. Walk the surface of Mars in your living room and interact with full-scale, realistic NASA Landers and Rovers. Learn about the Red Planet, its history, and its geography in this interactive experience. Play time: 20 min.

*Offer ends September 15 at 10AM Pacific Time

notes.title: Mars Odyssey will support Oculus Touch
notes.notes: We will be making a minor update patch in the next couple weeks to adjust a couple of visual items. We are planning a larger patch within the next couple months to add Oculus Touch support.
